## The Construction Staffing Challenge

Construction is project-based. You win contracts that require immediate staffing, but permanent hires become overhead between projects.

Experienced project managers and estimators are in high demand. Competitors poach your best people, and recruiting replacements takes months.

Office and administrative functions often get neglected during busy periods, leading to billing delays, documentation gaps, and compliance issues.

### The TaasFlow Solution

- Project managers with GC, subcontractor, and owner-rep experience
- Estimators familiar with your project types and bidding software
- Project coordinators and administrators who understand construction workflows
- Contract administrators and compliance specialists
- Flexible engagements that align with project timelines
